curatedMovie.curiosityHook: With Governor Ratcliffe plotting to humiliate her before the English court, can Pocahontas secure peace before his schemes prevail?
curatedMovie.description: Grieving the reported death of John Smith, Pocahontas travels to London alongside John Rolfe on a royal peace mission, only to face Governor Ratcliffe's ruthless plot to sabotage her standing with the King.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: An easy-watching, moderately emotional animated adventure with steady pace and lively court intrigue.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Running a swift 72 minutes, this animated adventure blends royal intrigue and romantic drama into a spirited, accessible family journey across the Atlantic.

facts.title: Pocahontas II: Journey to a New World
